06.06.2025 A.O. No. 166 of 2025
Hon’ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for the 
appellant.
2. Present appeal is preferred against the judgment 
and award dated 29.03.2025 passed by Presiding 
Officer/Employees Compensation Commissioner, 
Labour Court Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar 
in E.C.A. Case No. 09 of 2020, whereby learned 
Commissioner has awarded compensation of 
`7,67,160/- along with simple interest @12% per 
annum in favour of the respondents/claimants.
3. Learned counsel for the appellant would submit 
that the impugned award is unsustainable in the eyes 
of law as the same has been passed by the concerned 
Commissioner without considering the facts and 
evidence available on record.
4. Issue notice to respondents through ordinary 
process and registered post acknowledgment due as 
well as through e-mail and whatsapp, if available.
5. Steps to be taken within three weeks.
6. List this case on 25.07.2025.
7. Till the next date of listing, the execution of the 
impugned judgment and award dated 29.03.2025
passed by Presiding Officer/Employees Compensation 
Commissioner, Labour Court Kashipur, District 
Udham Singh Nagar in E.C.A. Case No. 09 of 2020
shall remain stayed.
(Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.)
06.06.2025
Mamta

AO No.166 of 2025
Hon’ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel 
for the appellant. 
2. Mr. Ketan Aswal, learned counsel for 
respondent nos.1 & 2.
3. Mr. Parikshit Saini, learned counsel for 
respondent no.3.
4. This money withdrawal application (IA 
No.2 of 2025) has been filed by respondent 
nos.1 & 2/claimants for withdrawal of the 
amount of compensation deposited by the 
appellant/corporation before learned
Court/Commissioner. 
5. Learned counsel for the appellant 
submits that the appellant has deposited 
entire awarded amount with the concerned 
Court. 
6. Having regard to the facts and 
circumstances of the case, money 
withdrawal application is allowed. Learned 
Court/Commissioner is directed to release 
50% out of the deposited amount in favour 
of respondent nos.1 & 2/claimants 
proportionately, without asking any security. 
The remaining amount shall be invested in 
an interest bearing scheme of a nationalized 
bank. 
7. List this case in due course.
8. Interim order, if any, to continue till 
the next date of listing.
 (Alok Mahra, J.) 
 10.10.2025
